title: TypeScript-style external .mori
user_visible_purpose: Recognize declarations and records
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Familiar punctuation can imply wrong host semantics; state exact grammar/profile
current_moriarty_gap: Syntax-only profile exists; TS alignment and full semantics open
minimal_acceptance_test: Compare clause meaning and repairs across experience groups; reject host JS expressions

title: Inert TypeScript tagged template
user_visible_purpose: Embed canonical source in TS build without callbacks
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: No interpolation or runtime AST escape; bytes and source maps must preserve bounds
current_moriarty_gap: No admitted embedding or source-map contract
minimal_acceptance_test: Template and file yield identical Core; reject interpolation and oversized source before evaluation

title: Unrestricted TS runtime in contracts
user_visible_purpose: Keep execution and proving finite
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: No closures, eval, ambient IO, host coercions or dynamic imports in trusted execution
current_moriarty_gap: Host witness boundary needs explicit validation
minimal_acceptance_test: Reject ambient clock/IO and arbitrary callback at source boundary

title: Explicit public financial types
user_visible_purpose: See asset, amount, share and duty roles
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Nominal units/identities; arithmetic checks additional to type checking
current_moriarty_gap: Types parse; full successor checker and nominal binding open
minimal_acceptance_test: Wrong asset/share payment rejects; valid same-unit payment preserves allocation

title: Local inference with visible inferred types
user_visible_purpose: Reduce repeated annotations while preserving meaning
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: No any/unsafe cast; inferred bounds and effects remain inspectable
current_moriarty_gap: Local static inference not implemented
minimal_acceptance_test: Explicit/inferred variants same Core; ambiguous units reject; developer repair study

title: Pure pre-state and staged updates
user_visible_purpose: Predict all changes before acceptance
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: No reading tentative next; failure atomicity; ordered diagnostic/effect policy
current_moriarty_gap: Proposal/parsing exists; full typed execution remains open
minimal_acceptance_test: Later guard failure discards tentative state/effects; remaining debt retained

title: Closed typed effects separate from authority
user_visible_purpose: Inspect what an action proposes and permits
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Effect membership is not spend permission; bind concrete complete effects
current_moriarty_gap: Successor effect typing and authority integration open
typescript_style_example: emit Transfer { asset: usd, amount: paid, ... };
minimal_acceptance_test: Right effect but wrong recipient or excess gross debit rejects

title: General resumable effect handlers
user_visible_purpose: Avoid hidden multiplicity in financial code
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Multiple resume can duplicate effects/work; single-shot/accounting theorem needed
current_moriarty_gap: No financial handler calculus or admitted use case
minimal_acceptance_test: Any future handler cannot duplicate nonce, payment or duty; bounded invocation proof

title: Finite event inputs and schedules
user_visible_purpose: Express delayed financial actions explicitly
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Bound queue, horizon, observations, ordering and recovery reserve
current_moriarty_gap: No successor schedule/observation declaration semantics
minimal_acceptance_test: Out-of-order duplicate/stale observation rejected by explicit policy; overflow preserves duty

title: Infinite streams or implicit lifetime reset
user_visible_purpose: Preserve finite admitted financial work
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Productivity/causality not finite lifetime; no unbounded queue or allowance refresh
current_moriarty_gap: Lifecycle work conservation still open
minimal_acceptance_test: Sequence exhausting allowance cannot regain it via continuation/split/join

title: Explicit residual duties and recovery
user_visible_purpose: Know what remains owed after progress
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: No duty discard through timeout/cancel/rename; reserve bounded recovery work
current_moriarty_gap: Partial financial utilities exist; general residual semantics open
minimal_acceptance_test: Partial payment plus expiry retains unpaid duty or authorized resolution

title: Checked arithmetic and named rounding
user_visible_purpose: Understand token/share conversion outcomes
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Intermediate bounds, scale, zero division and rejection explicit
current_moriarty_gap: Some atomic operations; successor rounding names merely parse
minimal_acceptance_test: Zero divisor/range overflow reject; opposite rounding changes expected share result

title: Structured source diagnostics
user_visible_purpose: Repair underlying financial mistake
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: No unsafe repair suggestions or private witness disclosure; truthful stage status
current_moriarty_gap: Syntax codes exist; semantic/proof/ledger diagnostics open
minimal_acceptance_test: Measure interpretation and correct next edit separately; no duty-erasing workaround

title: Content-addressed typed Core and dependencies
user_visible_purpose: Identify exact program and dependency closure
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Full refs/domain separation/nominal IDs; hash not equivalence or authority
current_moriarty_gap: No frozen successor Core encoding or semantic identity
minimal_acceptance_test: Rename-only and changed dependency have specified different identity behavior

title: Separate source/build/artifact/claim identities
user_visible_purpose: Understand what was reviewed, built and proved
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Hash complete immediate inputs; proof context/state/authority separate from code
current_moriarty_gap: Source hashes exist; complete cross-layer commitment contract open
minimal_acceptance_test: Change compiler/profile/verifier/observation; stale cached proof cannot admit new statement

title: Unison-style database as primary editor workflow
user_visible_purpose: Keep ordinary source review available first
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Storage/authorship/license/recovery cost; empirical benefit untested
current_moriarty_gap: Text workflow already exists; no demonstrated need for replacement
typescript_style_example: import { quote } from pinnedLibrary; // future syntax
minimal_acceptance_test: Future workflow must export complete reviewable source/provenance and handle upgrades

title: Explicit version and migration review
user_visible_purpose: Prevent silent reinterpretation of live duties
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Retain old program, claim lineage, nominal identity and authorized migration
current_moriarty_gap: No general private/live obligation migration acceptance
typescript_style_example: migrate oldRef to newRef under authority; // proposed
minimal_acceptance_test: Alias update cannot change prior obligation; authorized migration conserves duties/work

title: Separate preparation from proof and settlement
user_visible_purpose: Know whether an action actually happened
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Four mandatory claims plus native/ledger checks; no verified badge from parsing
current_moriarty_gap: Partial status flows; full financial acceptance remains open
minimal_acceptance_test: Well-typed/signed proposal with missing mandatory proof fails closed before acceptance

title: Human task evaluation before usability claims
user_visible_purpose: Verify understandable authoring and repair
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Expert PL votes are design review, not participant evidence
current_moriarty_gap: No developer study reproduced here
minimal_acceptance_test: Preregister correctness/time/repair/timeout; stratify experience; retain null outcomes

title: Profile-specific grammar and correspondence checks
user_visible_purpose: Keep published syntax and tools consistent
tradeoff_and_finite_resource_safety: Lexing/parsing/formatting separate from typing; stable spans and profile labels
current_moriarty_gap: Bounded syntax checks exist; semantic/Core/K/Compact correspondence open
minimal_acceptance_test: Grammar/lexer/parser/formatter/docs agree; formatter preserves AST, later all-layer financial observations
